# Vendored browser libraries

| File | Project | License | Used by |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| `opentype.min.js` | [opentype.js](https://github.com/opentypejs/opentype.js) 1.3.4 | MIT (`opentype.LICENSE`) | Font Foundry — parse TTF/OTF, write a **copy** |
| `leaflet/leaflet.js` | [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com/) 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`) | Wolven-cloak map |

Keep these offline so the toolbox does not need a CDN.
